thread:
maria: Heads-up — the onboarding sample-app is regularly hitting 429s for new orgs during the first 30s of traffic. Seen in prod and in local e2e runs.
kevin: Can you paste the logs? Is this a rate limiter or retries piling up?
maria: Logs below. Notice the token refresh + immediate retry sequence that replays the exact request without idempotency header. Probably why we get duplicate side-effects.
```
[2026-03-21T15:02:13Z] INFO request: POST /v1/generate 200
[2026-03-21T15:02:14Z] WARN request: POST /v1/generate 429 retrying
[2026-03-21T15:02:14Z] INFO auth: refresh token
[2026-03-21T15:02:14Z] INFO request: RETRY POST /v1/generate  -> 429
[2026-03-21T15:02:15Z] INFO request: RETRY POST /v1/generate -> 201 (duplicate created)
```
sam: Ouch. JS SDK's retry path reconstructs the body but we lost the original `Idempotency-Key` header (we only attach it in the outgoing request middleware). When refresh triggers mid-flight, the retried envelope is built from the request body only.
alisa: Does the python/go SDK behave the same? We want parity so onboarding sample-apps have consistent semantics across languages.
kevin: Quick check — python retains headers in retry wrapper, go does too. So it's a JS-only regression (likely introduced during the `auth` middleware refactor).
maria: Repro steps I used: 1) Run sample-app create-org flow with 40 concurrent users 2) throttle tokens via netem to force auth refresh timing 3) observe 429s and duplicate org rows.
sam: Minimal fix: when we create a retry envelope we must attach the original request.headers as metadata. Proposal: always stash `req._outgoingHeaders` and use them in retries. Patch sketch:```
// on outgoing request
const idKey = req.headers['idempotency-key'] || generateUuid();
req._outgoingHeaders = {...req.headers, 'idempotency-key': idKey};
// on retry
const retryReq = buildRetry(req.body, req._outgoingHeaders);
```
This keeps existing behavior for other SDKs and ensures server-side dedupe works.
kevin: Also recommend switching default backoff to full jitter. Our current linear-ish jitter still causes thundering herd under heavy throttling. Suggested algo (pseudo):```
function backoff(attempt) {
  const base = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** attempt, 16000);
  return Math.random() * base; // full jitter
}
```
sam: Agreed. Add a cap and make the SDK opt-out via client config. Also add `maxRetryAfter` to respect `Retry-After` header more strictly.
alisa: Tests to add: unit test that simulates mid-flight auth refresh and asserts `Idempotency-Key` present on retried request; e2e with sample-app that asserts exactly 1 org created for the flow.
ci-bot: Note: existing flaky test `sdk-js::auth-refresh` failing intermittently on main — likely related. See CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/23458 
kevin: I'll open a PR with the header-stash patch + backoff change + tests. Will also update sample-app to set explicit idempotency key per resource create to be extra-safe. Drafting now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/492 (WIP)
maria: Thanks — can you also add a short dev-ex note in the onboarding README about local netem repro steps? New hires keep hitting this and think the platform is buggy. :pray:
sam: I'll review the PR tomorrow. If green, we cut a patch release and flip the sample-app default.
kevin: created PR and added unit tests + e2e job. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/492/files
alisa: Nice. After merge, we should run a small dedicated capacity smoke-test to validate no regressions in Dedicated routing + caching layer.
maria: Plan LGTM. I'll coordinate with eng-sre for a brief smoke slot.
kevin: Follow-ups: (1) PR link above, (2) add a changelog blurb about idempotency header preservation, (3) update sample-app README with netem commands and recommended backoff settings.
ci-bot: Reminder: tests must run under `NODE_ENV=test` and with `CI=true` to be considered green.
maria: Great work team. This should reduce onboarding friction and stop confusing duplicate creates. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll merge after CI is green and cut a patch. Leaving a TODO to coordinate a tiny migration note for customers using custom retry middleware.
